domain_label: Tool Use, Retrieval & Agent Memory — RAG & Agent Memory subdomain
assumptions: no observed dataset or benchmark evidence supplied; all scores are heuristic priors
scope covers RAG pipeline engineering, agent memory tiers, personal-context store, and live-info grounding
evaluation is recall-and-faithfulness centric unless project overrides
a deployed LLM endpoint exists; LLM training is out of scope
exclusions: serving infrastructure beyond latency SLA constraints
crawling infrastructure (referenced only as corpus input)

competency_questions.question: What is the end-to-end RAG pipeline topology and what grounding policy governs when retrieval is used?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: RAG_ARCH defines topology and grounding policy

competency_questions.question: How is the RAG corpus segmented into chunks and what are the constraints on chunk size?
How is the embedding model selected or fine-tuned for the target domain?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: EMBED_MODEL defines selection and fine-tuning process

competency_questions.question: How are vector and lexical retrieval signals fused and how is the fusion weight tuned?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: HYBRID_RETRIEVAL defines fusion approach and tuning

competency_questions.question: When is retrieval skipped and how is the gating decision made?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: ADAPTIVE_RETRIEVAL defines gating policy and triggers

competency_questions.question: How is the RAG corpus index kept fresh as source documents change?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: INDEX_FRESHNESS defines update and staleness policy

competency_questions.question: How are retrieved passages assembled into the LLM prompt and how is context overflow handled?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CONTEXT_ASSEMBLY defines ordering, truncation, and citation

competency_questions.question: How is the faithfulness of generated answers to retrieved context verified?
How are citations formatted and attributed to source passages for front-end rendering?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CITATION_GROUNDING defines citation format and attribution

competency_questions.question: What memory tiers does the agent use and what are the read/write contracts per tier?
How does the agent decide what to write to memory and when to forget?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: MEM_WRITE defines write policy, deduplication, and expiry

competency_questions.question: How is the personal-context store designed and how does the front-end access it?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PERSONAL_CONTEXT_STORE defines schema, CRUD API, and access control

competency_questions.question: How are user preferences and long-term persona inferred and updated over time?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: LONG_TERM_PERSONA defines inference and update process

competency_questions.question: How are live-information tools integrated and how do they fail gracefully?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: LIVE_INFO_TOOLS defines integration and fallback policy

glossary.definition: Retrieval-Augmented Generation: a pattern that grounds LLM generation in retrieved external documents rather than relying purely on parametric knowledge
Dual-encoder model that independently encodes query and document into vectors for fast ANN retrieval
Model that jointly encodes query and document for precise relevance scoring at higher latency
Approximate Nearest Neighbor search: sub-linear retrieval by trading exact neighbor guarantees for speed
Reciprocal Rank Fusion: score-free fusion of ranked lists by summing 1/(k+rank) for each document
Hierarchical Navigable Small World graph: ANN index structure with log-scale build and sub-linear query
Hypothetical Document Embeddings: query expansion by generating a hypothetical answer and embedding it for retrieval
Degree to which generated claims are entailed by retrieved passages (not hallucinated)
Agent memory tier storing time-stamped events and interaction logs
Agent memory tier storing general facts and knowledge structured for query
OS-style mechanism for loading and evicting memory blocks between fast (context window) and slow (external store) storage
User-specific persistent store of preferences, facts, and interaction summaries accessible to agent and front-end

nodes.definition: Design the end-to-end RAG pipeline: offline indexing of a knowledge corpus, online retrieval of k documents per query, and grounded generation with the retrieved context.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: RAG topology changes or new retrieval paradigm adopted

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

nodes.definition: Select or fine-tune a dense embedding model (bi-encoder) for semantic similarity so that query and document vectors cluster by meaning rather than lexical overlap.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: MTEB leaderboard shows better model or domain shift detected

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

revisit_triggers: new embedding model released with +5% BEIR gain

nodes.definition: Build and serve an Approximate Nearest Neighbor index (HNSW, IVF-PQ, ScaNN) over document embeddings for sub-linear retrieval at scale.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: corpus scale milestone reached or embedding model swapped

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

nodes.definition: Combine BM25 lexical scores with dense vector retrieval scores via reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) or linear interpolation to achieve complementary coverage of exact-match and semantic recall.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: retrieval quality audit finds recall gap in either lexical or dense leg

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

acceptance_tests: hybrid recall@10 > max(bm25, dense) on held-out queries

nodes.definition: Re-rank the top-k retrieved candidates with a cross-encoder that jointly encodes query and document for more precise relevance scoring, accepting higher per-doc latency.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: retrieval latency budget changed or re-rank quality plateau

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

nodes.definition: Decide document segmentation strategy: chunk size, overlap, boundary heuristics (sentence/paragraph/semantic), and metadata propagation so retrieved chunks are self-contained and indexable.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: context window size changes or new corpus domain added

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

failure_modes: chunk too long fills context window
acceptance_tests: median chunk fits in 512 tokens with overlap

nodes.definition: Assemble retrieved chunks into the LLM prompt: ordering (lost-in-middle mitigation), deduplication, citation tagging, and hard truncation to respect context-window budget.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: LLM attention architecture changes or citation policy updated

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

failure_modes: lost-in-middle degrades recall of middle context

nodes.definition: Check that generated answers are supported by retrieved passages using an NLI model, LLM-as-judge, or rule-based citation verifier; flag or suppress unsupported claims.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: hallucination incident or verifier accuracy audit

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

nodes.definition: Classify agent memory into in-context (working), external episodic (event log), external semantic (knowledge store), and procedural (skill) tiers; define read/write contracts per tier.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: agent architecture redesign or new memory tier identified

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

acceptance_tests: all tiers have documented read/write SLAs
tier boundaries tested with failure injection
revisit_triggers: LLM context window makes in-context viable for more

nodes.definition: Implement agent memory write, update, and forget operations: decide what to persist after each interaction, how to deduplicate/merge with existing entries, and when to expire or delete stale facts.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: memory capacity incident or retention policy review

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

acceptance_tests: memory size stays within quota after 1000 interactions

nodes.definition: Retrieve relevant past memories (episodic events, personal facts, prior decisions) for the current agent turn using hybrid or semantic search, injecting them into the working context.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: user context relevance drops or memory latency increases

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

acceptance_tests: no stale-memory contradiction in injected context

nodes.definition: Design and implement the personal-context store that the front-end reads and writes: structured user preferences, interaction history summaries, and durable facts the user has stated; expose CRUD API accessible to both agent and client.

excluded: episodic event log internal to agent

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: privacy audit or user data complaint

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

nodes.definition: Expand or rewrite user queries before retrieval using techniques such as HyDE (hypothetical document embeddings), query-by-document, synonyms, or LLM-based sub-query decomposition.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: recall audit shows systematic query mismatch

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

failure_modes: latency doubled by LLM rewrite step

nodes.definition: Integrate live-information tools (web search API, structured data APIs, calendar/email connectors) into the agent tool-calling loop to supplement static RAG corpus with current information.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: API deprecation or live-data quality incident

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

failure_modes: stale cached result used as live
acceptance_tests: live tool results cited with retrieval timestamp
tool failure gracefully falls back to corpus

nodes.definition: Define how retrieved sources are cited in generated answers: inline citation format, source metadata (title, URL, chunk ID, retrieval timestamp), confidence annotation, and display contract for front-end rendering.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: citation accuracy audit or UI contract change

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

acceptance_tests: citation URL resolves to source chunk

nodes.definition: Evaluate RAG pipeline quality across retrieval (recall@k, MRR, context precision) and generation (faithfulness, answer relevance, completeness) dimensions using offline benchmarks and online feedback.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: production quality drop or evaluation audit

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

acceptance_tests: faithfulness metric correlated with human judgments

nodes.definition: Define and implement the policy for keeping the RAG corpus index fresh: incremental document ingestion, re-embedding on update, deletion propagation, and staleness SLA.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: source update velocity spike or staleness SLA breach

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

failure_modes: stale facts served after source update
acceptance_tests: deleted document absent from index within SLA
update lag < 1 hour for critical docs

nodes.definition: Implement the MemGPT-style paged memory pattern where the agent explicitly manages a fixed-size main context window by paging in and out external memory tiers, enabling effectively unbounded long-term agent memory.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: context window architecture changes or paging latency regression

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

failure_modes: thrashing if eviction and load loop
acceptance_tests: agent handles 10x context-window-length conversation without quality drop
revisit_triggers: LLM context window doubles making paging less necessary

nodes.definition: Implement privacy controls for agent memory: user consent capture before storing personal data, purpose limitation tagging, access controls, right-to-deletion enforcement, and data minimization for memory entries.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: regulatory change or privacy incident

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

failure_modes: delete request not propagated to all replicas
acceptance_tests: consent required before personal data written
delete honored in all stores within 24h

nodes.definition: Implement adaptive retrieval: the system decides per-query whether retrieval is needed (FLARE, Self-RAG) by predicting retrieval utility, avoiding retrieval latency for queries answerable from parametric knowledge.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: gating model accuracy drops or LLM knowledge cutoff changes

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

failure_modes: false negative: skipping retrieval for uncertain query
acceptance_tests: no accuracy loss vs always-retrieve on benchmark

nodes.definition: Build and maintain a long-term user persona model from interaction history: infer user expertise level, preferences, communication style, and domain focus; store as structured profile in personal-context store; use to personalize responses.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: persona accuracy feedback or user behavior shift

cons.claim: Adds retrieval latency and failure modes
cons.example: slow vector search degrades user experience

edges.label: architecture sets context budget for chunks
RAG arch scopes which memory tiers exist
RAG arch defines tool integration policy
trained encoder feeds ANN index build
ANN index provides dense ranked list
hybrid retrieval output is reranker input
chunk size sets vector granularity in index
personal context is source for persona inference
write ops check consent before persisting
expanded queries fed to hybrid retriever
adaptive layer decides when to retrieve
live tool results assembled alongside corpus chunks
reranker and live tool calls compete for latency budget
edges.resolution_rule: apply latency budget cap; prefer reranker on corpus queries, live tool for time-sensitive queries

edges.label: aggressive paging may evict embeddings needed for current task
edges.resolution_rule: tune eviction policy with recency+relevance score; never evict pinned task context

edges.label: consent restrictions limit how much history can feed persona model
edges.resolution_rule: persona inference only from consented data; provide minimal-data persona fallback

edges.label: running verifier costs latency offsetting adaptive retrieval savings
edges.resolution_rule: lightweight verifier (NLI) for gating; full verifier only for high-stakes answers

edges.label: very small chunks lose context; very large chunks may exceed token limit
edges.resolution_rule: sweep chunk size on dev set; use 256-512 token range as default with semantic boundary detection

conflict_axes.description: Adding more retrieval steps (reranking, live tools, adaptive routing) increases latency while improving quality; must be balanced per SLA.
conflict_axes.default_resolution: enforce per-turn latency budget; gate expensive steps behind quality threshold

conflict_axes.description: Richer long-term memory improves personalization but increases personal data storage and privacy risk.
conflict_axes.default_resolution: data minimization; purpose limitation; user-controlled deletion

conflict_axes.description: Smaller chunks improve retrieval precision but lose contextual coherence; larger chunks preserve context but dilute retrieval signal.
conflict_axes.default_resolution: semantic chunking with 256-512 token target and 10% overlap

conflict_axes.description: Dense retrieval handles semantic similarity but misses exact keyword matches; BM25 excels at lexical but not semantics; hybrid required but adds complexity.
conflict_axes.default_resolution: RRF fusion as default; tune alpha if labeled data available

conflict_axes.description: Continuous index updates for freshness can cause index inconsistency or recall regression; batch updates are stable but stale.
conflict_axes.default_resolution: incremental upsert with version lock; validate recall@10 after each batch

conflict_axes.description: LLMs carry parametric knowledge that may conflict with retrieved context; unclear which to trust for overlapping facts.
conflict_axes.default_resolution: retrieved context wins for grounded RAG; flag contradictions to user

conflict_axes.description: Aggressive persona-based personalization may create filter bubbles or discriminatory treatment; fairness requires some population-level uniformity.
conflict_axes.default_resolution: audit persona model for bias; maintain universal fallback responses

conflict_axes.description: Writing and indexing every interaction is expensive; selective writing saves cost but risks missing important context.
conflict_axes.default_resolution: salience-filter write policy; write only factual claims and user preferences

conflict_axes.description: Skipping retrieval saves latency but risks confidently wrong answers from parametric hallucination on factual queries.
conflict_axes.default_resolution: conservative gating threshold; always retrieve for fact-sensitive query intents

conflict_axes.description: Dense citation annotations improve verifiability but fragment answer fluency and increase prompt/output tokens.
conflict_axes.default_resolution: inline superscript citation with source sidebar; fluency-first with on-demand expansion

edge_cases.name: empty_retrieval_result
edge_cases.description: All retrieved chunks score below relevance threshold; LLM must answer from parametric knowledge or refuse.
edge_cases.recommended_action: detect empty retrieval; return 'no relevant documents found' + offer web search fallback

edge_cases.name: context_window_overflow
edge_cases.description: Sum of retrieved chunk tokens exceeds LLM context window; truncation required with risk of dropping most-relevant content.
edge_cases.recommended_action: truncate least-relevant chunks first; alert if top-5 chunks still overflow

edge_cases.name: embedding_model_version_change
edge_cases.description: Swapping embedding model invalidates existing ANN index; requires full re-index and regression test.
edge_cases.recommended_action: never hot-swap; blue-green index with parallel recall@10 validation before cutover

edge_cases.name: user_requests_memory_deletion
edge_cases.description: User invokes right-to-deletion; all personal memory entries must be removed from all stores within regulatory SLA.
edge_cases.recommended_action: propagate delete to all replicas; tombstone-and-purge; log completion timestamp for audit

edge_cases.name: hallucinated_citation
edge_cases.description: LLM generates a citation pointing to a non-existent or wrong source chunk.
edge_cases.trigger_condition: citation ID not found in retrieved context
edge_cases.recommended_action: citation verification step checks all IDs before rendering; strip uncorroborated citations

edge_cases.name: live_tool_api_failure
edge_cases.description: External API for live-info tool returns error or times out during agent turn.
edge_cases.recommended_action: graceful fallback to corpus RAG; include '[live data unavailable]' notice in answer

edge_cases.name: memory_paging_thrash
edge_cases.description: MemGPT-style pager evicts a memory page that is immediately needed again, causing repeated load/evict cycles.
edge_cases.trigger_condition: eviction immediately followed by load of same page within one turn
edge_cases.recommended_action: add recency pin for in-flight task context; increase min-dwell threshold before eviction

edge_cases.name: conflicting_retrieved_passages
edge_cases.description: Two retrieved chunks contain contradictory facts about the same entity.
edge_cases.trigger_condition: semantic contradiction detected between top-k chunks
edge_cases.recommended_action: surface both with timestamps; prefer more recent; flag conflict to user

edge_cases.name: query_expansion_drift
edge_cases.description: Query expansion produces semantically distant expansions that retrieve irrelevant documents, hurting precision.
edge_cases.recommended_action: evaluate each expansion independently; only include expansions that improve dev-set recall

edge_cases.name: persona_inference_error
edge_cases.description: Long-term persona model infers wrong user preference (e.g., expertise level), causing persistently miscalibrated responses.
edge_cases.recommended_action: provide explicit persona correction UI; weight explicit signals over inferred signals

edge_cases.name: ann_index_recall_regression_after_update
edge_cases.description: Incremental index update degrades ANN recall due to HNSW graph fragmentation.
edge_cases.recommended_action: trigger async re-index of affected shard; validate before serving; keep previous shard hot

edge_cases.name: consent_missing_for_existing_memory
edge_cases.description: Privacy policy updated to require explicit consent for data category already stored without consent.
edge_cases.recommended_action: audit existing store; purge or consent-gate unconsented entries; notify users

workflow.description: Define end-to-end RAG pipeline topology, component SLAs, and grounding policy.
workflow.decision_criteria: corpus > 10k docs warrants vector retrieval; hybrid if terminology-heavy domain

workflow.description: Classify memory tiers and write read/write contracts before implementation.
workflow.decision_criteria: long-lived agent requires episodic and semantic tiers; short-lived chatbot may need only in-context

workflow.description: Define chunk size, overlap, and boundary heuristics matching LLM context budget.
workflow.decision_criteria: 256-512 tokens with 10% overlap is robust default; smaller for factoid corpora

workflow.description: Select or fine-tune bi-encoder; evaluate on domain-relevant BEIR subsets.
workflow.decision_criteria: off-the-shelf if BEIR recall sufficient; fine-tune if domain gap > 5% recall

workflow.description: Build HNSW or IVF-PQ index; sweep ef/M/nprobe to hit recall-latency target.
workflow.decision_criteria: HNSW for < 50M vectors; IVF-PQ for larger; ScaNN if GPU available

workflow.description: Fuse BM25 and dense via RRF; tune fusion weight on dev recall@10.
workflow.decision_criteria: RRF k=60 robust default; tune alpha only if labeled data >= 200 queries

workflow.description: Add cross-encoder reranker for top-k; verify latency within budget.
workflow.decision_criteria: skip reranker if latency budget < 100ms; use distilled reranker for < 50ms

workflow.description: Implement write/update/forget with salience filter and deduplication; implement read with hybrid memory search.
workflow.decision_criteria: write only factual claims and stated preferences; forget after 90 days without access by default

workflow.description: Design personal-context schema and CRUD API; implement consent gating.
workflow.decision_criteria: separate personal store per user ID; enforce row-level isolation from day one

workflow.description: Capture consent before first personal write; tag each entry with purpose; wire deletion propagation.
workflow.decision_criteria: explicit opt-in required; retroactive consent audit on policy change

workflow.description: Assemble retrieved chunks into prompt with ordering, dedup, and citations; run faithfulness verifier.
workflow.decision_criteria: lost-in-middle: place most-relevant at start and end; run NLI verifier on high-stakes answers

workflow.description: Evaluate retrieval and generation quality; diagnose regression; feed back to upstream components.
workflow.decision_criteria: run offline eval on every model or index change; A/B gate online changes

dominance_rules.condition: PRIVACY_CONSENT flags consent missing for a personal data category
dominance_rules.rationale: regulatory compliance is non-negotiable; persona depth is capped by consent
suppress or correct unfaithful content before citation rendering

dominance_rules.condition: reranker inference would breach p99 latency SLA
dominance_rules.rationale: user experience requires latency SLA; skip reranker under budget pressure

dominance_rules.condition: user or legal deletion request received
dominance_rules.rationale: right-to-deletion is legally mandated; overrides index stability preferences
embedding training on wrong chunk size produces misaligned vectors; fix chunks first
memory tiers must fit within the retrieval architecture decision
reranker cannot recover candidates not retrieved; fix recall first
no promotion to production until offline quality gate passes
write without consent is a privacy violation; block the operation

dominance_rules.condition: retrieved passage contradicts LLM parametric knowledge on verifiable fact
dominance_rules.rationale: grounded RAG trusts retrieval over parametric memory for factual claims

anti_rework_rules.trigger: embedding re-run attempted without model version bump
anti_rework_rules.prevention: gate re-embedding on model version diff

anti_rework_rules.trigger: alpha tuning started without baseline recall@10 for each leg
anti_rework_rules.prevention: establish BM25 recall@10 and dense recall@10 independently first

anti_rework_rules.trigger: chunks defined without LLM context window spec
anti_rework_rules.prevention: lock context window budget before chunk size selection

anti_rework_rules.trigger: personal context CRUD API deployed without consent check
anti_rework_rules.prevention: consent middleware must be in place and tested before personal store goes live

anti_rework_rules.trigger: reranker deployed with first-stage recall@10 below threshold
anti_rework_rules.risk: reranker cannot fix recall deficit; latency cost wasted
anti_rework_rules.prevention: enforce recall gate before reranker integration

anti_rework_rules.trigger: BEIR or eval set overlaps embedding fine-tune train split
anti_rework_rules.prevention: strict train/eval split; use held-out queries for all retrieval metrics

anti_rework_rules.risk: unbounded memory growth; eventual OOM or quota breach
anti_rework_rules.prevention: default 90-day expiry must be set at deploy time

anti_rework_rules.risk: index incompatibility; recall regression in production
anti_rework_rules.prevention: build new index in parallel; validate recall; promote atomically
use lightweight NLI verifier always; full judge for flagged answers only

anti_rework_rules.trigger: LONG_TERM_PERSONA uses history before retroactive consent check
anti_rework_rules.prevention: persona inference gated on consented-history flag

iteration_protocol.action: run recall@10 diagnostic; identify which leg regressed; re-tune fusion or re-index
audit hallucinated claims; tighten verifier threshold or improve context assembly ordering
profile per-stage latency; disable most expensive optional stage; add caching
tighten salience filter; reduce retention window; run deduplication pass
freeze new personal writes; audit existing store for unconsented data; purge violations
evaluate new model on dev set; if recall improves > 3%, schedule blue-green re-index
expose persona edit UI; weight explicit corrections above inferred; re-evaluate on sample
re-evaluate chunk strategy for new domain; fine-tune embedding if domain gap detected; extend index
iteration_protocol.exit_condition: recall@10 on new domain meets threshold

iteration_protocol.action: tighten gating threshold toward always-retrieve; re-label gating training set
iteration_protocol.exit_condition: no accuracy drop vs always-retrieve baseline

priority_rationale: Ordered by foundational dependency and risk: architecture and memory taxonomy first; privacy and grounding (safety-critical) next; retrieval pipeline; operational/enhancement nodes last.

required_checks: all edge from/to reference valid node IDs
priority_order contains every node ID exactly once
high-risk nodes have non-empty acceptance_tests and human_review_required=true
conflict edges have signed_tension<0 and resolution_rule
observed_impact = 0.0 for all nodes (no observed data)
